entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's so hoooooot...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I feel like I'm being baked...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those girls are way too late...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It must be taking time for them to put on[n]the yukata.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why aren't you two wearing one?
entries.uk: А ви двоє чому без юкат?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't got clothes like yukata.
entries.uk: У мене немає такого одягу, як юката.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, you look way too normal in that.
entries.uk: Але, блін, ти в ній якось аж надто[n]природно виглядаєш.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: People often say that to me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah, by the way... The exams...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I bet you got a big fat F on them.
entries.uk: Закладаюся, ти їх із тріском завалив.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shuddup! We— We don't know that yet!
entries.uk: Замовкни! Ми... ми ще не знаємо!

entries.speaker: Lady in a Pink Yukata
entries.en: Are you going to the fireworks festival?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Lady in a Black Yukata
entries.en: Us too! Wanna go together?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are we... getting hit on!?

entries.speaker: Lady in a Pink Yukata
entries.en: C'mon, let's go together.

entries.speaker: Lady in a Black Yukata
entries.en: Do you happen to be a model? You look[n]great in that yukata.
entries.uk: Ти, часом, не модель? Тобі так[n]личить ця юката.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Waitin' around's a pain, so can we just[n]go with these chicks?
entries.uk: Чекати набридло, може, просто підемо[n]з цими красунями?

entries.en: Don't ask me.
No way.
Lemme think about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The ratio of guys to girls is off, but we[n]can do something about that later...
entries.uk: Хлопців і дівчат не порівну, але[n]з цим потім розберемося...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll both apologize to the others later!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A chance like this never comes up!
entries.uk: Такий шанс буває раз у житті!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's enough.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're disgracing your yukata.[n]You should be more aware of[n]your womanhood.
entries.uk: Ви ганьбите свої юкати.[n]Вам слід пам'ятати про свою[n]жіночність.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How could you!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't you go after them then?
entries.uk: То чого ж ти за ними не біжиш?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So those are the kinds of girls you like,[n]Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, well... That's...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You know, Yusuke's such a pretty boy,[n]but he is really missing out because of[n]what he says.
entries.uk: ...Знаєш, Юске такий красунчик, але[n]через те, що він каже, стільки втрачає.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess, but he's more likeable since he[n]stays true to his ideals.
entries.uk: Можливо, але він симпатичніший, бо[n]лишається вірним своїм ідеалам.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Definitely more than somebody I know.
entries.uk: Безперечно симпатичніший за декого,[n]кого я знаю.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I heard that Ryuji's pretty much failed[n]his exams.
entries.uk: Я чув, що Рюджі майже завалив[n]іспити.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mona, you little—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, it's gonna get crowded if we don't[n]get going.
entries.uk: Агов, якщо не підемо, буде тиснява.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Agreed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, you both look amazin' in[n]yukata! Talk about Japanese beauty...
entries.uk: Але ж, блін, ви обидві в юкатах просто[n]неймовірні! Оце японська краса...
